events.title: Playtest pausing for now - thanks everyone for the great feedback!
events.summary: We stated before that playtest would be shut down when the demo was released. We kept it open a bit longer than that due to high interest - but with essentially the same content as the demo during the last 1.5 weeks of the playtest.The plan now is to pause playtest applications for a while, according to earlier plan. We'll now sit down and work on major updates based on all the great feedback we've received during the playtest and from the demo players, and as we get more of those features in pl

events.title: More updates to the Demo version
events.summary: Some updates to the demoRemoved explosivity indicator on explosive barrelsAdded landmines (beta) both preexisting in the environment AND possible for players to lay down (known issues: collision isn't always responding - will be fixed in next demo release)Removed an unintended sphere visible in the main menu flyoverExplosive barrels can now be destroyed by sniper rifle and shotgun too (larger explosive objects - not present in the demo - will still only be destructible by explosions)A note to pl

events.title: Demo updates for Steam Next Fest
events.summary: Some updates to the demo in preparation for Steam Next Fest:Performance optimizationsReworked art style in the demo mapReworked art style in menus and HUD10 bugs fixed7 small features addedNot yet in scope:Online Multiplayer (as stated before, multiplayer will eventually be added to the demo as well, but most likely some time after Steam Next Fest, closer to the release of the full game)

events.title: Demo release time - what's included
events.summary: The demo should show up on the store page now or at the latest on the 8th (Thursday).A word of caution: we unfortunately didn't manage to resolve the last few issues with online multiplayer in time for the demo. Our current plan is to update the demo later - because we really want the online multiplayer to be included in the demo as well - but for now, the demo will offer local multiplayer and singleplayer.Local multiplayer is our favorite, and the recommended way to learn the game.
